pages.text: --- Page 1 --- NANGNI SONSULNA KA·SABO.
RONALD WILLIAMSON --- Page 3 --- NANGNI SONGSULNA KA·SABO Kristian Janggi tanganiko altuae uiatna segimin Ki'tap.
RONALD WILLIAMSON, M.A.
--- Page 5 --- AGANCHENGANI.
A'chik Kristian Book Clubni gitamgipa kitap baksana on'chapgipa, NANG-NI SONG- SULNA KA·SABO, REV.
Gilbert Marakni pe'skagimin kitap ong'a.

United Society for Christian Literature, London, England, chingna Key Book Series-o Englishchi segimin,(Love Your Neighbour by Ronald Williamson M.A.) kitapko Achikuona pe'skana on'ahani gimin chinga uamangko mitela.
Kristian janggi tangani, Isolni ka'saanina songsulna ka'saskae janggi tanganian ong'a ine iako poraigipa sakantian ma'sigen ine chingni ska aro namnika.
James M.
Wood.
--- Page 6 --- PE·SKAGIPANI AGANANI "NANG·NI SONGSULNA KA·SABO,"' ia kitapko segipa Ronald Williamson M.A.; Englandni Didsbury Collegeo Professor ong'- achim.
Ua 1957 oni 1961 bilsirangona Afri- cani Nigeriao, Missionary ong'e Immanuel College, Ibadano, Vice Principal aro Professor ong'e kamko ka'aha.
Ua Niam Gitalko ski- gipa ong'e, Kristian janggi tangani gimin ning'tue uigipa ong'achim.
Achik Kristian Book Club ia ki'tapko pe'skana aro chapa kaatna dakchakahan1 gimin anga kusi ong'a, aro mitelbea.
Ian Kristian janggi tangani gimin, segipa ki'tap- rangoni nambatsranggipa kingsa ki'tap ong'a.
Ia kitap anchingni Mondolirangni Kris- tianrangna bang'bea dakchakaniko on'gen ine anga bebera'a.
Kristian nokanti ia kitapko ra'na aro poraina nanga.

Maina iano, maikai Kristianni janggi tangani ong'na nanga, nok- dango maikai ka'sagrike janggi tangna nanga, Kristian songdonggipa a'songo maikai dongna nanga, aro maikai Kristianrang tangka paisako jakkalna nanga; iarang pilakni gimin seaha.
--- Page 7 --- Iako pe'skaanio Mr.
Pinsonath Momin, M.A., B.D.
angko namen dakchakbeaha.
Pe'- skaaniko namdapate, type dokan baksa, chapa ka'na gita pilakkon tariaha.
Uni ia dakchakani- rangna anga uko dingtangmancha mitela.
Pinsonath Momin, Book Clubo pilak sea jotani- rangko aro gipin gipin sea jotanirangkoba namatna gisik nangbegipa ong'a.
Uni ia kamo dongani gimin, an'ching rasong gnanggiparang ong'a ine aganna man'gen.
Pilak poraigiparangna Kristian janggi tang- anio, ia kitap dakchakani ong'gen ine ka'- donga.
Gilbert K.
Marak.
Tura, Garo Hills, Assam.
December 1967 --- Page 8 --- Ja'pang Katarang.
Odai.
Kristian Janggi Tangani gimin Niam Gitalo Maiko Agana ?
Odai II.
Kristian Janggi Tangani Ka'sae Janggi 15-28 Tangani Ong'a.
Odai.
Kristian Nokdang.
29-47 Odai.
IV A'songo Kristian Janggi Tangani 48—67 Odai.
Tangka Paisako Jakkalani.
6271 Matchotatani.
72-7: --- Page 9 --- Odai I Kristian Janggi Tangani  Gimin Niam Gitalo Maiko Agana ?
Kristian janggi tangania mai?
Uko mai dake ja'rikna nanga ?
Indakgipa sing'ani- rangko Mondolio, Kristianrang, aro.
a'palo Kristian ong'gijagiparangba uina ske da'ororo sing'tokenga.
Indakgipa sing'anirangko, ia ki'tapo aganchakna chinga joton ka'gen.
Iako Nama Katarango, Jisuni skianirango, chitirango aro Paulni skianirango pangchake aganchakgen.
Indiba aganchakna skang adita ma'siatchengna nanganirang donga.
KristianJanggi tangani Niamko ja'rikani ong'ja : Jisu Kristo an'tangni sninggiparangna mai somio, mai obostao, maiko dakna nanggen- chim, uarangni gimin niamrangko done ski- jahachim.
Iani bidingo ua sastro skigiparang- oni namen, dingtanggrikbeachim.
Uamang (Rabbis) Niam Gitchamo agangimin Niam- rangna agreba bang'bea salantio janggi tanga- nina niamrangkoba dake gatdapachim.
Indake --- Page 10 --- (2) Jihudirang minganti dakgnirangna niamrangko dake donsoahachim.
Ia pilak skianirangoni Jisuni skianirang namen dingtanggrikbeachim.
Jisuni skiani gitade, ia ka'mao on'gipa minggni ge'etani- rango pilak niamrangko man'gopachim.
"Na'a nang'ni pilak ka'tongchi, aro nang'ni pilak janggichi, aro nang'ni pilak gisikchi, aro nang'ni pilak bilchi nang'ni Gitel Isolna ka'sabo." "Naa an'tang songsulna an'tangna gitan ka'sabo." (Mk.
22 : 34-40.) Ia ge'etanirang Niam Gitchamoni onga ine nikgen.
(Deut.
6:5, Levi 19:18) Ia ge'- etanirang Isolna ka'sachina, aro songsulna ka'- sae dakchina skiani ong'a.
Aroba iarang, Isol mandeko maikai janggi tangatna namnikgen- chim, aro maiko dakatna nangnikgenchim, pilakon an'chingna mesoka.
Oe, iarangan, Jisuni an'chingna ongimin gital ge'etanirangba onga.
Chongmot dake agangenchimode, iarangko ge'etanirang ineba chana manja; maina, an'ching darangkoba saksa sakgipinko ka'sachina ge'etna ba draatna
